name: EffectCraft v0.11.1
body:
## What's Changed
* Atomic writes: a unique, exclusively created temp file per write (#1233) by @DWAA1660 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1345
* Offloaded analyses: merge the result instead of replacing the group (#1249) by @DWAA1660 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1366
* EPS: idiv and mod of -2^63 by -1 no longer panic by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1223
* Prevent duplicate automation edits after lost replies by @onlymoein in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1333
* Read PDF structure through the shared parser without changing vector rendering by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1398
* ci: add nix check workflow by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1612
* fix(render): preserve preceding effects in GPU Echo by @arnav-hiwarkar in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1412
* Copy only the selected keyframes across Position, Rotation and Scale (#1552) by @arnav-hiwarkar in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1584
* Import: Composition - Retain Layer Sizes for PDF / Illustrator files (#1536) by @arnav-hiwarkar in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1543
* fix(presets): identify copy folder action by label by @arnav-hiwarkar in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1402
* perf(presets): reuse cached text and user preset data by @arnav-hiwarkar in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1222
* feat(media-browser): add Copy Source Path by @arnav-hiwarkar in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1399
* perf(media-browser): reuse listings and cache filename sort keys by @arnav-hiwarkar in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1259
* perf(project): read file sizes once per sort by @arnav-hiwarkar in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1214
* fix(properties): reveal transform rows on double-click by @arnav-hiwarkar in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1472
* Docs: PDF / Illustrator Composition - Retain Layer Sizes in the parity docs by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1638
* #1221: two path-format test failures on Windows by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1254
* Footage: relinking a moved project keeps Windows separators and UNC shares by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1639
* Effects: 4-Color Gradient keeps the layer's alpha with Blending Mode None (refs #1381) by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1383
* Undefined-name errors report the first use from the failing function by @nanox333 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1349
* Import: AIFF files import, including EffectCraft's own AIFF renders by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1431
* Import: item.metadata counts a WebM's last frame when its duration is not a whole millisecond by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1435
* project: a hostile ROI cannot overflow the crop math by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1569
* Render Queue: resolve a bare project filename against the working directory by @Hamza0101 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1433
* CLI: an argument that is not Unicode is a usage error, not a panic by @iannitram in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1357
* macOS DMG: hdiutil create -srcfolder, so the installed app passes codesign --strict by @Deeev201 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1360
* Scripting: test that Layer.property() resolves AE's top-level shortcuts by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1371
* ui-egui: a click that opens the colour picker no longer closes it in the same frame (#1476) by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1496
* Solo: exclude other layers even when the soloed layer is outside its time range by @Themolx in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/948
* pdf: bound CFF endchar seac recursion so a cyclic font can't overflow the stack by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1477
* Liquify: expose Distortion Mesh Offset in Effect Controls (#1194) by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1302
* gpu: upload cache drops textures of freed buffers on every insert by @MatejKozlovsky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1549
* Settings: the page list's rows touch, with no gap between them by @pravdomil in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1258
* Update contributor key: moecr7 -> onlymoein by @onlymoein in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1397
* GPU: stop drawing a frame once the device has failed by @MatejKozlovsky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1520
* Packaging: repair the AppStream screenshot reference by @IanHollow in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1480
* i18n(ja): the resolution labels agree with the panel catalog and After Effects by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1307
* i18n(ja): four labels After Effects contradicts by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1312
* Scripting: add the missing app.preferences.saveToDisk() so imported scripts like Duik get past startup (#1263) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1311
* packaging: RPM requires library sonames, so openSUSE can install it by @tydude001 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1455
* pdf: don't slice glyph names at a non-char boundary in name_to_unicode by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1447
* ci: switch to shared nix workflow from craft-common-actions by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1622
* Find Missing Fonts: fonts found by their PostScript or full name are no longer listed by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1344
* UI: regression test — Space previews the demo opened from the start screen (#1059) by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1295
* Viewer: Composition Settings… in the composition's right-click menu by @nanox333 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1367
* Engine: sequence Interpret Footage loop regression coverage (#1068) by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1294
* pdf: an inline image with absurd dimensions falls back to the EI scan by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1566
* Reject corrupt benchmark results and incomplete regression evidence by @onlymoein in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1331
* i18n (de): fix two labels that name the wrong thing, and settle six terms by @Hamza0101 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1454
* Layer cache: hash a selected layer's comp scene into its owner's key by @DWAA1660 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1379
* Contributors: add Marco Arnulfo by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1608
* pdf: checked_add for CFF Private DICT and Type 1 RD offsets from the file by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1482
* CLI: a failed render under run/exec exits 1, like render --queue by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1432
* Timeline: dragging an effect lights up the layer it will land on by @nanox333 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1372
* fix(script): per-key methods act on keys outside the active comp (#1531) by @AyberkA0 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1558
* Window menu: choosing a checked panel closes it, as in After Effects by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1634
* Shapes: a stroke's buffer is padded by the miter limit only where it has miter joins by @wixar172 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1444
* GPU tests: say why the GPU didn't start, and fail with EFFECTCRAFT_REQUIRE_GPU=1 instead of skipping by @MatejKozlovsky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1524
* #1509: Timeline effect rows show the effect's colour label by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1512
* Scripts: a script can't confirm executing a file for itself (#1246) by @DWAA1660 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1351
* fix(viewer): Shift-click with the Pen draws a straight segment (#1544) by @AyberkA0 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1561
* Export: render in parallel once the GPU stops for good by @MatejKozlovsky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1511
* CC Particle World: motion blur (#1195) by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1292
* Effects: Black & White no longer turns faint colour noise in shadows into blocks by @guillehr2 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1538
* fix(graph): speed graph Fit Selection frames the curve between the keys by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1628
* Null layers: the Video switch hides them in the Composition viewer, as in After Effects by @Themolx in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1332
* i18n(ja): the first rows of the Japanese effect catalog by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1285
* Honor duration rounding in timeToFrames by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1321
* Preserve CLI template inputs when output is a hard link by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1313
* Honor --empty when rendering from the CLI by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1391
* fix(lottie): serialize Offset Paths miter limits as animatable values by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1470
* Masks: addVertex and setVertex fill in missing tangents of a loaded path (#1250) by @DWAA1660 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1318
* Expressions: accepting a function completion inserts the call parentheses by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1394
* Scripts: the project-folder check compares Windows paths in one form by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1647
* fix(web): scripts can open files in browser storage; stored footage isn't reported missing (#1593) by @rahal in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1594
* #1611: layer context menu has Layer Styles by @krinry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1640
* pdf: a soft mask at an unsupported bit depth is ignored, not fatal by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1565
* pdf: endchar takes its width by operand parity like the stems and rmoveto by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1478
* Fix autosave retries after failed background writes by @onlymoein in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1330
* Import templates and open originals within their own folders by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1748

## New Contributors
* @midasmatterhorn made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1569

* @IanHollow made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1480
* @tydude001 made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1455
* @AyberkA0 made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1558
* @wixar172 made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1444
* @guillehr2 made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1538
* @rahal made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1594
* @krinry made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1640
